name: Striving For Perfection
overview: Scripture calls believers to pursue a life marked by sincerity and uprightness, as God instructed Abram to 'walk before me, and be thou perfect' (Genesis 17:1). This striving for perfection reflects God's own holiness, as Jesus commands in Matthew 5:48 to be perfect as the heavenly Father is perfect. While humans are created from the dust (Genesis 2:7) and are inherently finite, God's loving plan offers redemption and eternal life through faith in Christ (John 3:16), enabling believers to grow toward spiritual maturity. This journey is grounded not in legalistic observance but in trusting God's promises and walking in His ways, assured by His thoughts of peace and hope for our future (Jeremiah 29:11).
